result_bytes.description: Bytes of each tool result kept in the audit log for the dashboard.
result_bytes.title: Result Bytes

retention_days.description: Audit events and background process logs older than this many days are deleted when the server starts. `null` keeps everything.
retention_days.title: Retention Days

default_timeout_s.description: Command timeout in seconds when the agent does not set one.
default_timeout_s.title: Default Timeout S

max_timeout_s.description: Longest timeout in seconds the agent may ask for.
max_timeout_s.title: Max Timeout S

max_output_bytes.description: Bytes of command output returned to the agent; the middle is cut out beyond this.
max_output_bytes.title: Max Output Bytes

max_read_bytes.description: Largest file or HTTP body, in bytes, that read tools return.
max_read_bytes.title: Max Read Bytes

max_processes.description: Most background processes that may run at the same time.
max_processes.title: Max Processes

memory_mb.description: Memory cap in MiB for each command and background process. Swap is not allowed, so past the cap the kernel kills the command. Enforced with a systemd user scope (`systemd-run --user`); the server refuses to start if that does not work. `null` means no cap.
memory_mb.title: Memory Mb

max_pids.description: Most processes and threads each command may have at once, counting the two that bubblewrap itself uses; further forks fail. JVM and Node runtimes start many threads, so leave room. Enforced like `memory_mb`. `null` means no cap.
max_pids.title: Max Pids

backend.description: How agent commands are isolated. `bubblewrap` confines them to the workspace (Linux only); `none` runs them with full access to your machine, like a coding agent run directly. `auto` uses bubblewrap and refuses to start when it cannot run here (not Linux, `bwrap` missing, or user namespaces blocked); it never falls back to `none`.
backend.title: Backend

network.description: Allow network access inside the sandbox.
network.title: Network

ro_paths.description: Host paths mounted read-only inside the sandbox in addition to the system folders. Missing paths are skipped, so one config works across machines.
ro_paths.title: Ro Paths

rw_paths.description: Host paths mounted read-write. Anything here is reachable by the agent.
rw_paths.title: Rw Paths

env_passthrough.description: Host environment variables copied into the sandbox. Everything else is dropped so server secrets do not leak into agent commands.
env_passthrough.title: Env Passthrough

env.description: Extra environment variables for agent commands. Values must be strings: quote numbers in YAML.
env.title: Env

host.description: Address to bind. Auth `none` is only allowed on a loopback address.
host.title: Host

auth.description: How MCP clients prove access. `path-token` puts a secret token in the URL path, `bearer` expects an `Authorization: Bearer` header, `none` turns auth off (loopback only).
auth.title: Auth

token.description: Fixed token for `path-token` and `bearer` auth. Empty means a new random token on every start. At least 16 characters, using only letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.` and `~`.
token.title: Token

public_url.description: Public base URL when the server sits behind a tunnel or proxy (e.g. `https://x.trycloudflare.com`). Its hostname is accepted automatically and the banner prints public URLs. Not allowed with auth `none`.
public_url.title: Public Url

allowed_hosts.description: Extra Host header values to accept, e.g. a tunnel hostname. Exact match, or `host:*` for any port. Not allowed with auth `none`.
allowed_hosts.title: Allowed Hosts

enabled.description: Groups to turn on that are off by default: the opt-in group `docker` and installed plugins.
enabled.title: Enabled

disabled.description: Tool groups to turn off, e.g. `http` or `browser`.
disabled.title: Disabled

disabled_tools.description: Single tools to remove, e.g. `run_command`. Names of tools in a group that is turned off or not installed are ignored, so one list works across machines.
disabled_tools.title: Disabled Tools

NoSettings.description: Settings of a group that has none: any key under `groups.<name>` is an error.
NoSettings.title: NoSettings

long_timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds for install_deps, run_tests and run_build when the agent does not set one. `limits.max_timeout_s` still caps it.
long_timeout_s.title: Long Timeout S

default_timeout_s.description: Total timeout in seconds for http_request, fetch_url and download_file when the agent does not set one. Must not exceed `limits.max_timeout_s`.
default_timeout_s.title: Default Timeout S

download_max_bytes.description: Largest download_file result in bytes when the agent does not set one.
download_max_bytes.title: Download Max Bytes

max_redirects.description: Most redirects a request follows before it fails.
max_redirects.title: Max Redirects

build_timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds for docker_build, docker_compose and a detached docker_run (which may pull an image) when the agent does not set one. `limits.max_timeout_s` still caps it.
build_timeout_s.title: Build Timeout S

headless.description: Run Chromium without a window. Set to false to watch the agent work on a desktop.
headless.title: Headless

max_pages.description: Most pages, popups included, that may be open at once.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

default_timeout_s.description: Seconds a browser action waits (for an element, a load, a script) when the agent does not set a timeout. `limits.max_timeout_s` still caps it.
default_timeout_s.title: Default Timeout S

idle_timeout_s.description: Seconds without any browser tool call after which all pages, Chromium and the Playwright driver are closed to free their memory. The next browser call starts them again; pages open at the time must be opened again. 0 keeps them running until the server stops.
idle_timeout_s.title: Idle Timeout S

workspace.description: Folder exposed to the agent and the only place it can write. Usually given as the command-line argument. Must not be `/`, your home folder, or a parent of it.
workspace.title: Workspace

state_dir.description: Where logs, the audit store and the sandbox home live. Must be outside the workspace. Default: `$XDG_STATE_HOME/dev-link-mcp/<folder name>-<hash>`.
state_dir.title: State Dir

log_level.description: Server log level. Lower case is accepted.
log_level.title: Log Level

limits.description: Timeouts, size limits and resource caps for tools.

groups.description: Settings of each tool group, keyed by group name. Each group checks its own keys at start; see Tool groups below.
groups.title: Groups
